title: The Frightened child in the corridor
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：frightened　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frightened 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the builder wrote of ① a frightened child in the corridor in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more frightened than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the frightened ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most frightened child in the corridor anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too frightened to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the frightened ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a frightened look in her eyes, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as frightened as the look in her eyes they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was frightened or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something frightened, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite frightened; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the frightened ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, for the whole place, she wrote of another frightened child in the corridor in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more frightened than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most frightened look in her eyes in the whole site, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the frightened ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 受惊（前置定语 a frightened child in the corridor：1976 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件受惊的孩子）
B. adj. 受惊／害怕（比较级 more frightened than：文中两处，一处比走廊里受惊的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 受惊／害怕（最高级 the most frightened：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 受惊（表语 too frightened to do：母亲觉得它太受惊，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 害怕（前置定语 a frightened look in her eyes：叔叔把整件事称作一桩害怕的惊恐）
F. adj. 害怕（同级比较 as frightened as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩她眼里的惊恐相比）
G. adj. 害怕（后置定语 something frightened：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 害怕（受程度副词修饰 quite frightened：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a frightened child in the corridor
the most frightened child in the corridor anybody
a frightened look in her eyes
The most frightened look in her eyes in

answers.why: frightened 意为“受惊”，1976 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件受惊的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a frightened child in the corridor。
frightened 意为“受惊”，此处用比较级 more frightened than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
frightened 意为“受惊”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最受惊的一件，故用最高级 the most frightened child in the corridor。
frightened 意为“受惊”，母亲认为这件东西“太受惊了，谁也用不上”，too frightened to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
frightened 意为“害怕”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩害怕的惊恐”，此处作前置定语 a frightened look in her eyes。
frightened 意为“害怕”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩她眼里的惊恐一样害怕”，同级比较用 as frightened as。
frightened 意为“害怕”，施工图上那半行字要的是“害怕的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something frightened。
frightened 意为“害怕”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当害怕”，quite 修饰原级 frightened。
frightened 意为“害怕”，1986 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要害怕”，故用比较级 more frightened than。
frightened 意为“害怕”，母亲 1988 年说的是“整个工地里最害怕的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most frightened look in her eyes。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件受惊的孩子。（a frightened child in the corridor）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更受惊。（more frightened than …）
母亲觉得它太受惊，谁也用不上。（too frightened to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩害怕的惊恐。（a frightened look in her eyes）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩她眼里的惊恐一样害怕。（as frightened as …）
到了 1983 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件害怕的东西。（something frightened）
answers: In 1976 the builder wrote of a frightened child in the corridor in the plan.
Everybody said it was more frightened than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too frightened to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a frightened look in her eyes.
He said nobody would call it as frightened as the look in her eyes they had once had.
By 1983 the plan asked for nothing but something frightened.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 frightened 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the builder wrote of a frightened child in the corridor in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most frightened child in the corridor in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too frightened to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a frightened look in her eyes, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite frightened, and everybody laughed.
The frightened ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
